_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Setting up a session from your template…

description: Set up a NEW session from one of the user's templates, e.g. 'set up my Level 10 for next Tuesday'. Give the template's name (or id); without one, or when nothing matches, it lists the user's templates. Optionally a title and a date/time for the new session. Free: no AI runs, the template is copied with its fixed activities. Counts as a session for the free plan's limit.

date.description: When the new session takes place, as ISO 8601 date-time with offset if known (e.g. 2026-12-02T09:00:00+01:00). Work out relative dates ('next Tuesday') yourself.

name.description: Title for the new session. Default: the template's name.

template.description: The template's name (or part of it) or its id.

name: use_template
title: Use a template
